steps.response:
The image displays an axial cross-section of the thorax with high spatial resolution, distinct bone density (bright white), and air-filled lung parenchyma (dark black). These are characteristic features of Computed Tomography (CT), specifically a chest CT in a lung window setting. It is not an X-ray (which is a projection) or MRI (where cortical bone is typically dark).
